name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, you mustn't let your guard down just because you've finished attacking!」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you expect your opponent to wait for you, you'll pay a painful price!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Those two are really going at it again today, huh」

name: Ria
message: 「Though, they look like they're having fun somehow」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahaha, and we're totally beat over here\s02」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun, shall we wrap things up soon...?」

name: Soltia
message: 「He seems to have grown stronger than I expected...」

name: Soltia
message: 「He's like a completely different person from when he was in the Demon World...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Still, right now, taking his back would be effortless...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Even the Witch of Nibe looks somewhat worn out, after all」

name: Virus
message: 「If you too are one who seeks power, why not face each other fair and square」

name: Soltia
message: 「Would you mind not lumping me in with a brute like you」

name: Virus
message: 「Hmph...... If you're not inclined, then so be it」

name: Virus
message: 「However, the Demon Lord is my opponent」

name: Soltia
message: 「If you two tear each other apart, that suits me just fine」

name: Soltia
message: 「So long as the Demon Lord is disposed of, nothing else matters」

name: Virus
message: 「I will defeat the Demon Lord. However, now is not yet the time」

name: Soltia
message: 「Still, whatever plans you two have are of no concern to me」

name: Soltia
message: 「After all...... everything is going to vanish into nothingness anyway!」

name: Virus
message: 「So you intend to stand in my way to the very end」
Just now, for a split second, did massive powers just clash nearby......?

name: Melilot
message: 「Just now, I sensed a massive release of magical power.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It doesn't seem to be very far... though I can't pinpoint the exact location.」

name: Synn
message: 「...It looks like it was only for a split second just now, though.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed. However, there is no doubt they are a considerable wielder.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's not unthinkable, but if that's the case, there's no need to rise to such provocation.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Either way, he likely wouldn't challenge us to a match at this stage.」

name: Melilot
message: 「If it were, there's no reason they wouldn't have ambushed us just a moment ago.」

name: Synn
message: 「And I can't feel anything anymore now...」

name: Melilot
message: 「For the time being, it's safe to assume there's no immediate danger.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Just to be safe, though, it would be best to wrap up our special training here.」
If Melilot-san says so, it probably isn't an urgent situation.
Still, it would be a lie to say that the sensation from just now doesn't bother me at all.
If I just let a threat roam free and it causes trouble later, I won't be the only one who suffers.

name: Synn
message: 「Shouldn't we at least do a patrol around town, just in case?」

name: Synn
message: 「What just happened is still bothering me, after all...」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're right. If that's the case, we have no choice.」
Besides, I want to spend a little more time alone with Melilot-san...

name: Virus
message: 「What's the matter? Your aim is sloppy!」

name: Virus
message: 「I thought you'd have a bit more backbone... Is this all you've got?」

name: Virus
message: 「Hmph... Clinging to such an uncertain existence is laughable」

name: Virus
message: 「The only thing you can trust in this world is your own strength」

name: Virus
message: 「There is no victory for someone who has forgotten that」

name: Soltia
message: 「Victory to me is the fulfillment of Re-Crea and rebirth into a new world!」

name: Soltia
message: 「My ideals are on a completely different level from a petty existence like you!」

name: Virus
message: 「What is this, at a time like this......」

name: Azel
message: 「......Art thou the one who mocks the Lord?」

name: Soltia
message: 「This is none other than the ultimate vessel graced by God's favor......」

name: Soltia
message: 「The true form of the one who acts as proxy for Re-Crea!」

name: Virus
message: 「This latent potential, surpassing even me and the Demon Lord......」

name: Virus
message: 「Are you telling me this is the power of God...... of Re-Crea......!」

name: Azel
message: 「The Lord's will shall not be hindered by any being.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Though this power has yet to reach its zenith, its energy is far too immense......」

name: Soltia
message: 「Even someone like you must realize it, no? That there is nothing you can do anymore.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Your power alone amounts to little more than this, after all!」

name: Virus
message: 「To think there would be an opponent even more worth fighting than the Demon Lord!」

name: Virus
message: 「The Demon Lord is amassing ample strength, and as if in answer, a divine envoy who surpasses even him has appeared!」

name: Soltia
message: 「...Has he truly gone mad, I wonder」

name: Soltia
message: 「Even though we are trying to purify everything in this world...」

name: Virus
message: 「Yeah, that's right. Because that would be boring!」

name: Virus
message: 「I'm taking you down right here and now!」

name: Synn
message: 「...In the end, I haven't sensed anything at all since then」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. However, having things remain peaceful is a good thing」

name: Synn
message: 「Though it ended up feeling just like an ordinary walk...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Something like this isn't so bad, wouldn't you say...」

name: Synn
message: 「...You're right. If you say so, Miss Melilot」
Sure, that strange feeling from earlier is still on my mind, though...
If nothing actually happened, then all the better.
No matter how strong Melilot-san is, I still don't want her running into danger.

name: Melilot
message: 「You were spacing out again. Are you all right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I was just thinking about you, Melilot-san」

name: Melilot
message: 「Y-You weren't thinking about something dirty, were you\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaat! That's a misunderstanding! Just a little bit!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you're dressed pretty lightly, so I was just worried you might be cold!」
Well, it is true that I was worried, though…….

name: Synn
message: 「Um, are you really not cold, Melilot-san」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry... for dragging you all the way out to a place like this...」

name: Melilot
message: 「A little walk around town is no trouble at all」

name: Melilot
message: 「Besides, being with you makes it feel much more fun than usual, Sakura-kun...」

name: Synn
message: 「Christmas is just around the corner, after all」

name: Melilot
message: 「I've heard the Student Council has its hands full preparing for the Holy Night Festival, too」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, things are going smoothly enough, so we're hanging in there」

name: Melilot
message: 「With all the special training overlapping too……」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I want to spend a wonderful Holy Night Festival with you, Melilot-san」
